title: arrhenatherum elatius subsp. sardoum
intro: Arrhenatherum elatius subsp. sardoum, commonly known as Sardinian oat-grass, is a subspecies of the Arrhenatherum elatius plant, native to the Mediterranean region, including the island of Sardinia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Sardinian oat-grass include calming and sedative effects, which may help to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
